name: @huddle/game-trivia
description: Trivia Game Module: metadata, settings schema, reducer, and TV/Controller screens.
//exports: `./logic` is the rules without the screens, and exists so the Convex server can import them without bundling React Native. A module's screens are properties of it and do not tree-shake, so the seam has to be an entry point rather than a hope about the bundler.
//peerDependencies: Screens only, and for the same reason `@huddle/ui` declares them this way: `react-native` resolves to whichever variant the consuming app installed — react-native-tvos on the TV, stock on the phone. The `./logic` entry point imports none of it, which is what lets the Convex server take the rules without any of this.
